reactions: [Hacker News] I find myself on the side of the publishers. What a weird turn of events for someone who spent his youth on Napster and Kazaa.

[Hacker News] The quote from Sony/warner: > “Defendants Anthropic and its founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann have conducted a brazen campaign of illegally torrenting, scraping, and downloading copyrighted works on a massive scale in order to develop, operate, and reap enormous profits from Anthropic's 'Claude' series of artificial intelligence ('AI') models," the plain
[Hacker News] I had the idea to extort Anthropic before the music publishers did. They have blatantly stolen my idea and owe me all the money they collect.
